en.home.hero_title: AI systems, from research to production.
en.home.hero_subtitle: I build efficient, reliable AI systems — from GPU kernels to robotic learning. Here I share the code, experiments and engineering decisions behind my work.
en.home.focus_subtitle: Three connected areas of applied research and engineering.
en.home.focus_compute_body: Efficient models, CUDA kernels and the systems that run them.
en.home.focus_embodied_body: Learning from language, interaction and brain signals.
en.home.focus_energy_body: Classical and quantum methods, tested against practical constraints.
en.home.projects_subtitle: Explore the architecture, experiments and source code behind four systems.
en.projects.title: Four projects, with code and open questions
en.projects.subtitle: GPU inference, robotics, EEG and energy optimization: explore the implementations, available evidence and next validation steps.
en.blog.subtitle: Engineering notes on the systems I build, with experiments, trade-offs and links to the code. Technical articles are currently available in English.
en.home.flash_body: CUDA and Triton kernels for attention, activation fusion and cache operations. Explore the implementation, correctness boundaries and GPU validation requirements.
en.home.robo_body: A MuJoCo manipulation testbed with mock planning, scripted baselines and SAC experiments. Explore what is tested and what remains to be learned.
en.home.neuro_body: An EEG transformer prototype for masked reconstruction and motor-imagery classification, with data separation and evaluation as the current priorities.
en.home.quantum_body: Synthetic unit-commitment experiments using QUBO, QAOA, VQE and classical solvers. Explore the formulation and requirements for a fair comparison.
en.footer.tagline: Applied AI and systems engineering. Code, experiments and technical notes.

fr.home.hero_subtitle: Je conçois des systèmes d’IA efficaces et fiables, des kernels GPU à l’apprentissage robotique. Je partage ici le code, les expériences et les décisions techniques qui accompagnent mon travail.
